    • Hours: Most stores will follow regular operating hours.
    • Pharmacy: Pharmacy hours may vary or operate on a reduced schedule.
    • Location Check: Use the Walmart store locator to confirm hours for your specific location.
    • Alternative Shopping: While Walmart is open, other retailers like Target and Costco will be closed.
